options: to be liable for; to stick
quiz.answer: to be liable for; to stick

quiz.fullAnswer: Eltern sind für ihre Kinder haftbar.

goodToKnow: Haftbar means liable: für etwas haftbar sein, jemanden haftbar machen. Haften für means to be liable for. The famous building-site sign Eltern haften für ihre Kinder is legally misleading: parents are only liable if they neglected supervision. Die Haftpflichtversicherung (personal liability insurance) is held by most Germans. Not to be confused with die Haft (detention).
